data.name: Hilalah
data.gender_notes: Hilalah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman named Hilalah means 'Moon' or 'Night'. In Islamic tradition, the crescent moon signifies the beginning of a new month and is a symbol of peace, renewal, and hope. The name Hilalah carries the meaning “Moon, Night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hilalah usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the beginning of new cycles and opportunities for spiritual growth. Representative of peace, renewal, and hope.
data.etymology: Hilalah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, Night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hilalah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة هلال التي تعبر عن ضوء القمر في بداية الشهر الهجري، ويعبر عن نور القمر أو إشراقه. يعتبر هذا الاسم ذا دلالة دينية وثقافية كبيرة في الإسلام، حيث يرتبط بالشهور القمرية والهجري

in_english.name: Hilalah

in_english.long_meaning: A feminine given name of Arabic origin, derived from 'hilal', meaning the crescent moon or its first light. In Islamic tradition, the name Hilalah holds cultural and religious significance, reflecting the importance of lunar cycles and the natural world

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the crescent moon is an essential symbol that marks the beginning of a new lunar month. People look forward to the sighting of the crescent moon, as it is a sign of peace and renewal. The Islamic calendar is a lunar calendar, and the new moon signals the start of a new month and hence new opportunities. Therefore, the name Hilalah signifies the embodiment of these cultural values, representing the start of new beginnings, peace, and growth.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Hilalah signifies the innocence, purity, and beauty of the night sky and the relationship between the earth, the moon, and the Divine. In Islamic tradition, the crescent moon represents the separation of light from darkness, reminding us of the presence of God in both. Thus, the name Hilalah symbolizes the idea of being a beacon of light and signing the existence of God in all aspects of life. The spiritual significance of the name Hilalah is also grounded in the understanding of the role of nature and the rhythms of life in maintaining a deep connection to the Divine.
